title: Add Management Component Transport Protocol (MCTP) dissector
description:
This series adds support for the Management Component Transport Protocol (MCTP) and NVMe Management Interface (NVMe-MI) dissectors.

These are currently fairly basic, but provide fundamental message reassembly and header field display.

The NVMe-MI conversation tracking is fairly unsophisticated at present, I'm certainly open to any improvements!

Of course, any comments / feedback / queries are most welcome.

commits_data.title: Add NVMe Management Interface (NVMe-MI) dissector
commits_data.message:
Add NVMe Management Interface (NVMe-MI) dissector

This change adds a small dissector for the NVMe-MI protocol, typically
for tunelling Administration commands over an MCTP (over I2C) channel.

We just decode the request and response headers, and leave the payload
as raw data.

Signed-off-by: Jeremy Kerr <jk@codeconstruct.com.au>

commits_data.title: Add Management Component Transport Protocol (MCTP) dissector
commits_data.message:
Add Management Component Transport Protocol (MCTP) dissector

This change adds a protocol dissector for the Management Component
Transport Protocol (MCTP). This is a failry simple datagram-based
protocol for messaging between components within a single platform,
typically over I2C, serial or PCIe.

This dissector just implements the header fields, and sequence-number
based message reassembly. Inner protocols will be added as follow-up
changes.

Linux has support for AF_MCTP data, so decode from the MCTP SLL ltype.

Signed-off-by: Jeremy Kerr <jk@codeconstruct.com.au>
